name: Caribbean Cruise West Indian Cream of Plantain Soup vs. Pigeon Pea / Black Bean Soup
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure, Magic & Wonder · Caribbean Cruise Menus
searchKeywords: west indian cream of plantain soup
whyItWorks: Puréed West Indian Cream of Plantain Soup harnesses the gut-soothing soluble starch of green/ripe plantains blended completely smooth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Always choose the smooth Cream of Plantain Soup (with a Lactaid) over the fibrous Pigeon Pea or Black Bean soups on Caribbean sailings.
watchOuts: Avoid whole black bean or pigeon pea soups during flares due to legume hulls
